clue.text: They're right between north and east or south and west

definitions.text: They're right between north and east or south and west

parts.words: They're right between north and east or south and west
parts.note: north and east sit ninety degrees apart on a compass, as do south and west, so what lies between them are right ones

explanation.walkthrough: 'right' hides its geometric sense: a right one is ninety degrees, the gap between neighbouring compass points.
explanation.definitionFit: Neighbouring compass points are separated by a quarter turn, which is a right one of these geometric measures.

clue.text: A dandy too

parts.note: a swell is a fashionable dandy

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means in addition, which is what too means.

clue.text: Boris perhaps oddly dour with number in government

parts.note: GOV is short for government

explanation.surface: A dour Boris holding a number in government.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Boris' suggests a modern politician; it is the Tsar Boris Godunov of Pushkin and Mussorgsky.
explanation.definitionFit: Boris Godunov was a Russian tsar, so he is an example of a Boris.

clue.text: The best possible year on record after exchange

clue.text: Piece of advice is clear — well-bred horse told to go inside

explanation.walkthrough: 'well-bred' is U, the old label for upper-class usage; 'told' marks a child's word for a horse said aloud.

clue.text: Mainly give adverse publicity angle in kind

clue.text: Attic needs clearing out after student leaves

explanation.definitionFit: Attic describes ancient Athens and its region, so it is a Greek or classical style.

clue.text: Harangue current clientele outside

clue.text: Take aim to bag bird

clue.text: Is after single old coin in unusual means test

explanation.definitionFit: Amniocentesis is a prenatal medical test of the fluid around a foetus.

clue.text: Extra leg's good for stuffing duck

clue.text: Without question, marquess changed into rubber

clue.text: Woman has article translated from English to French in a Channel Island?

clue.text: Wife and partner, one turning to hold hands in kind of romance?

clue.text: Almost aim too high — one beset by a lot possibly panics

clue.text: Briefly boast about whale

clue.text: Female sightseer removing braces systematically

clue.text: Thriller with intro and finale swapped in a twist of sorts?

clue.text: Good man about which to laugh?
